faq.pageLead: Answers about Agrocyms registration, farm management features, subscriptions, account setup, and using the platform.

what.question: What is Agrocyms?
what.answer: Agrocyms is a digital farm management platform designed to help agricultural businesses organize farm operations and manage farming information in one place.

who.question: Who can use Agrocyms?
who.answer: Agrocyms is intended for crop farming businesses, livestock operations, farm managers, and other agricultural businesses whose needs match the platform's available functionality. During setup you choose poultry, goats and sheep, cattle, pigs, crops, or a mix.

account.question: How do I create an account?
account.answer: Visit the registration page, enter the requested information, name the farm, choose enterprises and crops, and create the first owner account. Any additional onboarding steps are shown during signup.

crops.question: Does Agrocyms support crop farming?
crops.answer: Yes. You can name the crops this farm grows during setup, then record planting, fertilizer, spray, irrigation, and harvest on the crop records page beside livestock work.

livestock.question: Does Agrocyms support livestock farming?
livestock.answer: Yes. Poultry, goats and sheep, cattle, and pigs each have their own records inside the same farm account. Consult the livestock management page for the capabilities in the live application.

multi.question: Can I manage more than one enterprise?
multi.answer: Yes. Setup lets you pick more than one enterprise. Poultry pages stay separate from cattle or crop lists, but they share the same login. Additional locations and user limits depend on what your account supports.

free.question: Is Agrocyms free?
free.answer: New farms get 90 days of full access with no card required. After the trial, the workspace stays readable and exportable until you subscribe. There is no unlimited free plan.

cost.question: How much does Agrocyms cost?
cost.answer: The first 90 days are included with farm setup. After that, subscription prices depend on the published plans. Visit the pricing page or contact Agrocyms for current prices, billing intervals, and included features.

subscribe.question: How do I subscribe?
subscribe.answer: Create your farm account and use the 90-day trial. When you are ready to keep writing records, contact Agrocyms or complete the payment process supported in the product.

cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
cancel.answer: Cancellation is subject to the subscription terms displayed when you purchase. Consult the account billing area or the contact page for instructions.

support.question: How do I contact support?
support.answer: Use the contact page to ask about registration, subscriptions, or platform functionality.

inventory.question: Does Agrocyms track feed and medicine?
inventory.answer: Yes. Feed stock and medicine use sit on the same farm as the animals they belong to, so inventory is not a separate notebook.

install.question: Can I install Agrocyms on my phone or computer?
install.answer: Yes. Agrocyms is a progressive web app. On Android, Windows, and most desktop browsers, use Install when it appears. On iPhone and iPad, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On a Mac in Safari, choose File then Add to Dock.
